Package com.kristensoft.kdc

Interface KristenHttpServerEventHandler

  • All Known Implementing Classes:
    KristenHttpServerEventAdapter
    public interface KristenHttpServerEventHandler
    Receives lifecycle, context, and agent events from a KristenHttpServer.

    Implementations may be registered with KristenHttpServerParameters to receive notifications as the HTTP server is created, started, stopped, and processes HTTP contexts and agents.

    Applications interested in only selected events may extend KristenHttpServerEventAdapter instead of implementing every method in this interface.

    Author:
    Charles B. Kozoyed
    See Also:
    KristenHttpServer, KristenHttpServerEventAdapter, KristenHttpServerParameters
